proposals.relationship: Argues for integrating social histories of ordinary lives into world-history comparison and periodization.
proposals.evidence_note: Own2005essay1–25 develops research and teaching links, including comparative concepts, contextualizing contemporary issues and global social change. He preserves distinct purposes for both fields and treats periodizations as questions rather than universal laws. This is a field contribution, not membership in a single global-history school.
